ticket.summary: Build a scoped Markdown command-template library.
requirements: Parse an optional YAML header into validated namespace, description, and tag metadata.
Build a recursive Markdown catalog with canonical keys and safe template lookup.
List templates by metadata and render {{name}} placeholders from the indexed template body.

ticket.goal: Turn a Markdown template into a validated metadata record and body that another module can consume.
requirements: Handle an optional YAML header and validate namespace, description, and tags before returning the parsed record.
Keep this state focused on the metadata contract rather than catalog traversal or rendering.
ticket.validation: Run the public tests and use the metadata parsing check as the primary evidence for this state.

ticket.goal: Build a safe recursive catalog that consumes parsed templates through the supplied metadata contract.
requirements: Implement discovery and lookup in template_library/catalog/index.py.
Use canonical nested keys, ignore non-Markdown files, and reject unsafe lookup keys.
Keep this state focused on catalog behavior rather than changing the metadata parser or the library facade.
ticket.validation: Run the public tests and use the recursive catalog check as the primary evidence for this state.
